integrity: The displayed spectrum, sharp norm inequality and all-edge uniqueness argument are analytical. Numerical checks are finite corroboration; no independent review was performed.
scientific_limitations: Positive alternating edge prices on even cycles under a single total conductance-price budget; no claims for odd cycles, irregular price profiles, degree constraints or discrete-time SLEM. Priority remains subject to specialized earlier coverage.
title: Unique budget-optimal spectral gaps on alternating-price cycles
